nodes.name: Update Checking for Invoice in Excel

parameters.jsCode:
function text(value, fallback = '') {
  if (value === undefined || value === null) return fallback;
  const s = String(value).trim();
  return s === '' ? fallback : s;
}

function joinList(values) {
  if (!Array.isArray(values) || values.length === 0) return '';
  return values
    .map(v => String(v || '').trim())
    .filter(Boolean)
    .join('; ');
}

return items.map(item => {
  const j = item.json || {};
  const base = j.excel_row_base || {};
  const reqeli = j.reqeli_result || {};

  const pkg = reqeli.package || {};
  const artifactPaths = reqeli.artifact_paths || {};

  const failureModes = Array.isArray(pkg.failure_modes) ? pkg.failure_modes : [];
  const risks = Array.isArray(pkg.risk_library) ? pkg.risk_library : [];

  return {
    json: {
      report_id: text(j.report_id || base.report_id),
      process_id: text(base.process_id),
      process_instance_id: text(base.process_instance_id),
      process_build_id: text(base.process_build_id),
      workflow_engine: text(base.workflow_engine),
      workflow_id: text(base.workflow_id),
      workflow_run_id: text(base.workflow_run_id),
      workflow_report_id: text(j.workflow_report_id || base.workflow_report_id),
      source_report_id: text(j.source_report_id || base.source_report_id),
      reported_at: text(base.reported_at),
      processed_at: text(base.processed_at),
      document_ref: text(base.document_ref),
      report_source: text(base.report_source),

      'Invoice No': text(base['Invoice No']),
      'Invoice Date': text(base['Invoice Date']),
      'VAT-ID (Seller)': text(base['VAT-ID (Seller)']),
      'VAT-ID (Buyer)': text(base['VAT-ID (Buyer)']),
      'Name (Seller)': text(base['Name (Seller)']),
      'Address (Seller)': text(base['Address (Seller)']),
      'Zip (Seller)': text(base['Zip (Seller)']),
      'City (Seller)': text(base['City (Seller)']),
      'Country (Seller)': text(base['Country (Seller)']),
      'Name (Buyer)': text(base['Name (Buyer)']),
      'Address (Buyer)': text(base['Address (Buyer)']),
      'Zip (Buyer)': text(base['Zip (Buyer)']),
      'City (Buyer)': text(base['City (Buyer)']),
      'Country (Buyer)': text(base['Country (Buyer)']),

      'K1 Control ID': text(base['K1 Control ID']),
      'K1 Control Title': text(base['K1 Control Title']),
      'K1 Status': text(base['K1 Status']),
      'Matched Recipient ID': text(base['Matched Recipient ID']),
      'Match Type': text(base['Match Type']),
      'Buyer Name Match': text(base['Buyer Name Match']),
      'Buyer Address Match': text(base['Buyer Address Match']),
      'Buyer Zip Match': text(base['Buyer Zip Match']),
      'Buyer City Match': text(base['Buyer City Match']),
      'Buyer Country Match': text(base['Buyer Country Match']),
      'K1 Reason Codes': text(base['K1 Reason Codes']),

      'K2 Control ID': text(base['K2 Control ID']),
      'K2 Control Title': text(base['K2 Control Title']),
      'K2 Status': text(base['K2 Status']),
      'Supplier VAT ID Checked': text(base['Supplier VAT ID Checked']),
      'Buyer VAT ID Identified': text(base['Buyer VAT ID Identified']),
      'BZSt Response Status': text(base['BZSt Response Status']),
      'BZSt Checked At': text(base['BZSt Checked At']),
      'K2 Reason Codes': text(base['K2 Reason Codes']),

      'Trigger ReqEli': text(base['Trigger ReqEli']),
      'Trigger Flag': text(base['Trigger Flag']),
      'Trigger Reason': text(base['Trigger Reason']),

      'ReqEli Run Status': reqeli.report ? 'completed' : text(base['ReqEli Run Status']),
      'ReqEli Output Dir': text(
        artifactPaths.tax_risk_report_path ||
        artifactPaths.requirements_package_path ||
        base['ReqEli Output Dir']
      ),

      'Failure Mode IDs': joinList(failureModes.map(x => x.fm_id)),
      'Failure Mode Titles': joinList(failureModes.map(x => x.fm_title)),
      'Tax Hazard IDs': joinList(risks.map(x => x.tax_hazard?.hazard_id)),
      'Tax Hazard Titles': joinList(risks.map(x => x.tax_hazard?.hazard_title)),
      'Tax Hazard Status': joinList(risks.map(x => x.tax_hazard?.lifecycle_status || x.tax_hazard?.status)),
      'Tax Risk IDs': joinList(risks.map(x => x.risk_id)),
      'Tax Risk Titles': joinList(risks.map(x => x.risk_title)),
      'Tax Risk Status': joinList(risks.map(x => x.risk_lifecycle_status))
    }
  };
});
